skills.skill: Find the area of a rectangle as length × width
Find an unknown side of a rectangle given its area and the other side

misconceptions.pattern: Adds the two sides (or computes the perimeter) instead of multiplying them for area (e.g. an 8 by 8 rectangle answered 16 or 32 rather than 64).
Multiplies the area by the known side instead of dividing when finding the unknown side.

strategies.intent: See the rectangle as rows and columns of unit squares — the area is how many squares fill it, which is the number in a row times the number of rows.
Area = one side × the other, so the missing side undoes that: divide the area by the side you know.
